shadows.name: card-shadow
shadows.purpose: Small lift on public service and testimonial cards.

components.name: WhatsApp action
components.css: .ds-chat { background: oklch(52.7% 0.154 150.069); color: white; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; padding: .625rem 1.5rem; font: 600 .875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-chat:hover { background: oklch(44.8% 0.119 151.328); } .ds-chat:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold, #b45309); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Price list action
components.css: .ds-prices { background: oklch(21.6% 0.006 56.043); color: white; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; padding: .625rem 1.5rem; font: 600 .875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-prices:hover { background: oklch(37.4% 0.01 67.558); } .ds-prices:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold, #b45309); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Admin field
components.description: A bordered input with a visible label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; font: 500 .875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { display: block; box-sizing: border-box; margin-top: .25rem; min-height: 2.75rem; width: 100%; border: 1px solid oklch(87% 0 none); border-radius: .5rem; padding: 0 .75rem; font: 400 .875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold, #b45309); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Active admin tab
components.description: The current destination in the desktop dashboard.
components.css: .ds-nav { width: 100%; text-align: left; border: 0; border-radius: .5rem; background: var(--color-gold-soft, #f7ead3); color: var(--color-gold-deep, #92400e); padding: .625rem .75rem; font: 600 .875rem/1.25rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-gold, #b45309); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Featured service badge
components.description: The small label for the featured service.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-gold-soft, #f7ead3); color: var(--color-gold-deep, #92400e); padding: .25rem .75rem; font: 700 .75rem/1rem Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .025em; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / .1); }

components.name: Service card
components.description: A service summary with an emphasized price.
components.css: .ds-service { background: white; color: var(--color-espresso, #2e2620); border: 1px solid oklch(92.3% .003 48.717 / .7); border-radius: 1rem; padding: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / .1); font-family: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-service h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-service p { margin: .5rem 0 0; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 800; } .ds-service small { font-size: .75rem; font-weight: 400; color: oklch(55.3% .013 58.071); }
